mapper.select: SELECT es.snapshot_id::text AS snapshotId, v.version_number AS versionNumber FROM agent a JOIN tenant_agent_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN agent_version v ON v.agent_id = a.agent_id AND (b.pinned_version IS NULL OR v.version_number = b.pinned_version) JOIN execution_snapshot es ON es.version_id = v.version_id WHERE a.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND v.published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1
